subject.title: fix: WebChat stop fails for WeChat channel sessions

question: Should this narrower selected-channel `/stop` fix land independently before the broader WebChat Stop recovery work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92003?
rationale: The patch is focused and well-proven, but it changes abort targeting across hidden channel runs, reply-run registry state, and visible WebChat session selection.

options.title: Land the narrow fix now
options.body: Accept the supplied WeChat and multi-channel isolation proof, then keep broader same-session Stop recovery in the separate PR.

options.title: Wait for broader recovery
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide whether the broader Stop recovery PR should absorb or precede the channel-session targeting change.

options.title: Request owner smoke
options.body: Ask an owner to run an exact-head selected-channel WebChat stop smoke if independent confirmation is needed before taking the session/message-delivery risk.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow fix now
recommendation.body: Accept the supplied WeChat and multi-channel isolation proof, then keep broader same-session Stop recovery in the separate PR.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent review and merge-history signal across the touched Gateway abort and WebChat lifecycle paths.
